newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 1.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section:
WASHINGTON - Comsat Corp. expands a plan to divest some of its assets in an effort to revive its earnings after a difficult year.
WASHINGTON - Audio Buys Inc., a consumer electronics chain based in Fairfax, filed for protection from creditors under Chapter 11 of the bankruptcy code.

WASHINGTON - The oil industry has discovered a rich source of oil and gas and the surprise is that it's in the Gulf of Mexico, a site once viewed as a mature oil province, living out its productive life.
